ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface across approximately 90% of the visible area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity zone across the central and inner lobe areas; distinct high-intensity white geometric blobs are mapped to the extreme lateral margins (distal tips) of the fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a wide obtuse angle (estimated at ~130-140 degrees) at the convergence of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrated boundary; peaks and valleys are clearly visible with a pixel-amplitude of 3-7 pixels, showing higher frequency toward the distal lateral margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex upward curve fitted from the median notch extending to the elevated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (1-4 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark central and right lobe regions; small dark pixel clusters visible within the white distal tip zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single light-colored linear pixel disruption oriented diagonally on the left lobe, though resolution limits absolute confirmation.

other_distinctive_markers: Motion blur artifacts present along the trailing edge and significant water spray/occlusion at the junction where the fluke meets the peduncle.
